s_4f2b22855bfd: Five routes checked against sources on 9 October 2026, an extended directory of 169 leads and 59 sections of four long-distance trails. The original recommendations were circular walks of roughly 5 km or more, within about 90 minutes of Ramat Gan, excluding the Jerusalem area. These are historical selection criteria, not a promise of driving time.
s_7498e449f117: 150 routes came from a shared document and 19 from public sources. Personal information and the original document link are not published. Landscape tags are search aids drawn from names and source descriptions. Unverified fields remain "unknown".
s_21ccc83f431e: The directory's closure check was a broad comparison against the Israel Nature and Parks Authority's page, updated on 6 July 2026 and checked on 9 October 2026, not a field check of each route. Section data comes from Naakeb, Shvilist and the Golan Field School, without checks of military restrictions, water or closures.
s_efcc8c908201: City estimates use OSRM road distances measured on 9 October 2026, divided by 60 km/h and rounded to five minutes. City origins are approximate points. Earlier Ramat Gan and Jerusalem estimates are kept separately and do not necessarily start at the city centre.
s_8942156570f4: Address search runs only on submission. Before road routing, the dynamic estimate is straight-line distance multiplied by 1.35, not road distance. OSRM time, when available, excludes live traffic. Public services are rate-limited and may fail. The 46 records without a verified start point have no pin or drive estimate.

s_3b7b521d7ebf: Kula Forest was removed after a KKL-JNF notice of the Alexandroni Trail closure and tree-felling work. Oranit Cave, Cyclamen Hill and Nahal Keini were excluded due to warnings or closures in the original check. Habonim Coast (2.5 km) and Horshim Forest (3.5 km) were too short; the springs route at Nahal Taninim (5.9 km) is linear and needs two vehicles. These are historical findings, not current conditions.
s_8b297893df1e: Saved trails stay on your device. There are no user accounts or analytics. Search addresses and routing origins are sent to OpenStreetMap and OSRM through this site's server and cached for up to seven days, with automatic deletion within eight days. Do not enter personal or confidential information. Map tiles load directly from OpenStreetMap. Hosting infrastructure and external services may keep access logs.
